evidence: Labeled Wallet and modifies wallet transaction creation RPCs in src/wallet/rpc/spend.cpp and src/wallet/spend.cpp.
rationale: Deprecates the redundant `replaceable` argument across wallet RPCs (`send`, `fundrawtransaction`, `bumpfee`) following network adoption of full-RBF as default policy. It cleans up the interface and lays groundwork for complete argument removal in #32661 without affecting fund safety or wallet stability.
